cmes.note: Though the X9.3 flare disturbed some of the AIA images, it was still clear a strong CME with wave had taken place in the AIA data after the flare peak (12:02Z).
Flare, dimming and expanding loops and wave from AR 2673 starting 19:19UT, signatures visible in all AIA wavelengths.

The signatures of this CME are somewhat subtle, flare and some loop expansion visible in AIA 171/193 starting after the M1.0 flare (2017-09-04  15:25) lifting off during the M1.5 flare (2017-09-04  18:05).
